proposal.summary: An Android application com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted (<= 1.0.1) allows any installed app with no permissions to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent to com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity.
proposal.cwe_quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

A.quote: place phone calls without user interaction

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerable component behaviour by testing whether an unprivileged app can invoke DialerActivity with an intent that triggers an outgoing call; if confirmed, ensure the activity requires appropriate permissions or intent filtering and prepare a patch and coordinated disclosure.
